title: P0 — comment input focus theft
prompt: Users can't type into the comment input. Desktop: must hold the mouse down while typing; releasing breaks focus. Mobile: keyboard dismisses mid-type. Find the TRUE root cause (evidence, no guessing), implement the smallest safe fix, review, validate.

rulesFired: Detected: focus-trap useEffect depended on [onClose] (new identity every parent render) and called panelRef.focus() in its body → focus stolen from the input on every ancestor re-render.
Heuristic applied: latest-ref pattern + mount-once [] effect — robust to any re-render cadence.
Gate G3 (5-reviewer): security + qa always-on; ui routed (CommentsSheet.tsx matched ui-ux paths); mobile-performance routed (touch/keyboard surface).
Gate rule: only `critical` blocks the aggregator — 0 critical → not blocked.

screens.note: Shipped before this visualization layer existed — no retroactive capture possible. Future runs capture via `npm run loop:snapshot` with a dev server up.

scores.note: ui reviewer: no styling/animation change — Glass tokens untouched.
Grounded in a real functional bug: input was unusable -> smooth.
mobile-perf reviewer: removed per-render focus()/listener churn.
ui reviewer: role=dialog, focus-visible, 44px targets all intact.
Average of the above; the objective proof is the Measured panel.
